name: BELLICUM PHARMACEUTICALS INC
summary: BELLICUM PHARMACEUTICALS INC is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing novel therapeutics for unmet medical needs in neuroinflammatory and neurodegenerative diseases. Headquartered in Englewood Cliffs, New Jersey, the company's pipeline includes product candidates targeting conditions such as autism spectrum disorder (ASD) and Alzheimer's disease. They aim to develop therapies that improve cognitive and behavioral function.
